scope_notes: Public BooleanDifference commands ran at idle in an empty owned document on private Xvfb. No proprietary implementation was inspected.
Fresh-scheme defaults were measured first; later recipes seeded deterministic DeleteInput and DeleteCutters values with owned overlapping solids.
Targets are processed separately. Disjoint targets are copied when another target cuts successfully; noninteracting interior cutters are ignored.
Split results lose geometry user text; other results retain target text. Accepted options survive cancellation. DeleteCutters is hidden when DeleteInput is No.
EndCommand and script-return snapshots retain source retention, attributes, groups, selection, cancellation, option memory and undo/redo.
These convex-polyhedral witnesses do not establish arbitrary curved geometry parity, continuous boundary error, all internal face partitions or native kernel speed.

Eight supplemental public commands measure axis splits, multiple disconnected components, reversed cutter picks, and partial coplanar cutter partitions. Raw disconnected-piece order is retained; replays match components within their target by location and report ordering differences.

One partial coplanar recipe retains 13 faces in both implementations but 31 kernel edges versus 33 native edges. The replay asserts this recorded seam-ownership difference explicitly and compares all other counts, metadata, mass properties and physical boundary witnesses.
